newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Mortgage Agency yields 5.85 pct in 2028.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Mortgage Agency yields 5.85 pct in 2028.

text.p: STATE OF NEW YORK MORTGAGE AGENCY
ALL BONDS ARE PRICED AT PAR.
(Avg. Life: 4.04 years based on 100% of FHA experience)
See Preliminary Official Statement pages 1-5 through 1-7 for information on special redemption at par from prepayments, excess revenues, and unexpended proceeds.

The Series 65 term bonds maturing on 10/1/2012, 4/1/2020, and 10/1/2028 and the Series 66 term bonds maturing on 10/1/2017 and 10/1/27 are also subject to mandatory redemption from sinking fund payments as described in the Preliminary Official Statement on page 1-B-1. The Series 65 term bonds maturing on 4/1/2020 are also subject to special mandatory redemption as described in the Preliminary Official Statement on pages 1-7 and 1-8.
ALL BONDS ARE PRICED AT PAR.

See Preliminary Official Statement pages 1-5 through 1-7 for information on special redemption at par from prepayments, excess revenues, and unexpended proceeds. The Series 65 term bonds maturing on 10/1/2012, 4/1/2020, and 10/1/2028 and the Series 66 term bonds maturing on 10/1/2017 and 10/1/27 are also subject to mandatory redemption from sinking fund payments as described in the Preliminary Official Statement on page 1-B-1.
The compliance addendum MSRB Rule G-11 will apply.
The award is expected Thursday, June 19, 1997.
This issue is book entry. DTC is pending.
BNY Capital Markets, Inc. a subsidiary of The Bank of New York Co.
